deaths.title: Ran out of memory, then stopped -- victoria-metric was growing

verdict.title: Ran out of memory, then stopped -- victoria-metric was growing
verdict.summary: edge was thrashing when the record ends at {{clock}}: memory was exhausted and the machine spent its last minute reclaiming instead of running. It then stopped writing its journal without a shutdown, which is what a machine does when it hangs under memory pressure (or is reset for it). The process that grew most was victoria-metric.
because: The recorder's last minute (10 min recorded in all): CPU 68%, 88 MB available at the lowest, memory stall 44% (PSI full), IO stall 1%, load 6.3, 3 task(s) in D-state.
no shutdown record in the journal; the previous boot's last entry is at {{clock}}
the kernel killed prometheus (pid 2826.0) for memory 41 s before the end
victoria-metric (pid 2777) grew most: grew 2,745 MB in 10 min (275.5 MB/min)
context: Memory will run out in about 12 min (led by victoria-metric) was active 9 min before the end

findings_at_end: Memory will run out in about 12 min

verdict.title: Rebooted by sam (reboot)
verdict.summary: nas went down cleanly at {{clock}}: systemd ran its shutdown path, asked for by sam (reboot). Nothing crashed.
because: The recorder's last minute (10 min recorded in all): CPU 8%, 15,300 MB available at the lowest, memory stall 0% (PSI full), IO stall 1%, load 1.1.
sam ran `sam : TTY=pts/0 ; PWD=/home/sam ; USER=root ; COMMAND=/usr/sbin/reboot` 14 s before the end
the shutdown path ran: "Reached target Reboot." 2 s before the end
journald closed its files normally ("Journal stopped")
